title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) — Architecture
summary: Select and configure agent tools, set up MCP servers with registries and allow lists, integrate agents into CI, and implement safe execution with robust error handling.

blocks.text: **MCP Flow:** Agent → calls MCP server → which calls external API → returns structured result to agent

rows: Wraps an external API/service as callable tools
Must be registered in registry before use
Catalogue of available servers Copilot knows about
Specifies which servers an agent is permitted to call
What each tool can do (read/write/delete) within its scope

blocks.code:
# Example: GitHub remote MCP server config
mcp_servers:
  - name: "jira-mcp"
    url: "https://mcp.jira.example.com/sse"
    type: "url"
mcp_allow_list:
  - "jira-mcp"  # only this server is permitted

blocks.text: **Exam Trap:** Allow list ≠ tool permissions. Allow list = which servers are reachable. Tool permissions = what operations each server can perform. Both layers are required for least-privilege.
